chapter: Brother Lorenzo Tio Jr. and his career
title: Piron photograph at the Roseland and the 1915 old-timers photo
summary: Tio names players in the Piron band picture that went to the Roseland in New York, inscribed to him in February 1924, and moves to a second photo dated 1915.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: This is a little British subject. It was named Clarence Segari, who was a bass tuba. And that's Steve Lewis, Charles Bookreis, Juanique, Juanique, that's my brother. And this is Luca Trev. Now, that was the whole outset here that went to New York and played at the Roseland.
I forgot where they were. I noticed this is addressed, this autographed by...
Armand Perron, he gave me, that was to me. To? Louis Teo.
Louis Teo. And it was February 28th, 1924.
That's about the time they went to New York, was it, or a little later?
No, that was just after they come back from New York, I think it was. And this is some of the old timers. You asked me the name of some of the old timers.
Oh, yes. You think this date is about right? They give it 1915 here. 1915, that's about right. I think that's about right.
